windows_trust: Self-signed; cryptographic signature and PE digest checked with an explicit certificate pin. No system trust changes.
signed_emulator_checks: API 28 and 30: final signed APK; actual authenticated app-UID root access; offline model load; microphone and Accessibility acknowledgment.
API 28 and 30: fresh nonce on an already open setup activity; rapid superseding requests; microphone denial and subsequent grant are reported correctly.
API 28: clean setup and same-signer update. Signer migration in both directions with explicit button-service detachment succeeds without reboot.
API 28 and 30: official Frida 17.26.2 x86_64 injector runs Java code in our app under SELinux Enforcing.
Access generation tested from the actual installer shell template with only the emulator BusyBox path substituted: repeat provisioning, start, stop, restart, stale lock and foreign listener.
Simulated zero free space prevents model extraction and keeps existing files. Raising the capacity allows actual native English model load; a ready model reopens without extraction reserve.
code_and_fixture_checks: Overseas f6811 main and passenger navigation classes: display routing, explicit Home/All apps assignment, native hold/failure fallback, constructor tracking and two-bar restoration acknowledgment (7 JavaScript fixtures).
QG steering callbacks on SDK 28/30: voice/custom/camera constants, shared down-time deduplication and native fallback; both callback signatures required.
Steering readiness marker is required when steering assignments are enabled.
Local Authenticode verification passes Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7; changed PE content, wrong certificate and unsigned input are rejected.
Portable APK verifier starts offline and verifies the release certificate. Every archive member matches SHA256SUMS.txt.

windows_rendering.backend: Native GDI and controls; blocking message pump
windows_rendering.scope: 24-second bounded demo, tab switch, hide, restore; no ongoing paint loop; GPU telemetry not measured

limits: No vehicle or ARM64 OEM process was executed. No cold-boot, sleep/wake, CAN telemetry or actual passenger-display qualification.
Exact firmware, OEM APK and operation catalogs remain empty; no vehicle action is approved by this build.
Direct raw CAN steering interception and overseas account switching/backup/restore are not implemented.
Overseas foreground icon highlighting is absent; all OEM adapters need exact firmware validation.
A single local APK is supported. App catalog/store and split/APKS installation are separate missing capabilities.
The complete installer preparation on an OEM ARM64 system image remains untested; emulator access scripts do not certify OEM remount or root boot context.
The local Windows certificate is not a publicly trusted publisher certificate.
